headline: The signals gaps are closed and the live pages have their search hygiene; question pages wait on Pavol's pick, and nobody has finished a practice set yet because a set is a whole okruh.

shipped.title: Signals contract: allow-list test, drop automated browsers, analytics bundle guard
shipped.live_checked: deploy run green with the guard step; live bundle carries https://chgwirzbpspoaoposuwg.supabase.co

shipped.title: Search hygiene on live pages: FAQPage JSON-LD on topic pages, llms.txt
shipped.live_checked: /okruh/dopravni-znacky/ serves one FAQPage block and no WebApplication; /llms.txt serves the corrected citation counts; /sitemap.xml has 8 URLs

signals_fixed: Signals contract test added (src/platform/flywheel-events.contract.test.ts + flywheel-events.json, allow-list v2 of 2026-10-27).
flywheel-client drops events from automated browsers (navigator.webdriver or a bot/headless UA), so Playwright, Lighthouse and crawlers no longer count as visitors.

Analytics bundle guard in CI (node scripts/check-analytics.mjs dist # flywheel:analytics-guard) on main pushes, right before upload-pages-artifact. The dist is built in the test job, so the guard sits there.
Guard deviation from the kit: it matches https://<ref>.supabase.co. supabase-js carries '*.supabase.co' in every bundle, so the kit's bare-string check passed a build with no Supabase config.
CI concurrency confirmed: group ci-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress only off main. No change was needed.

Activation wiring verified. A test finishes a practice set through the UI and sees one conversion(); a client test sees conversion() insert an events row named 'conversion'. The live policy 'log known events' lists conversion, and an anon insert in a rolled-back transaction succeeded.

no_activation explained, not fixed. Live events over 14 days show no session_finish, lesson_complete or exam_finish, so nobody reached a results screen. An okruh practice set is the whole okruh (35–444 questions), and that is a teaching decision for Pavol.

notes: Key via #19: public/9cc2dcb0952bc859471bd181b22e3dcb.txt, served at https://autoskola.dravec.org/9cc2dcb0952bc859471bd181b22e3dcb.txt (HTTP 200, checked 2026-10-28). Submission is by flywheel's central daily workflow (04:23 UTC), first run after #19 deployed.

One manual submission was made before the orchestrator's 'central submission' note reached this session: 2026-10-28T03:50Z, 8 URLs (the full live sitemap), with the #19 key. Bing (https://www.bing.com/indexnow) answered HTTP 202 and Seznam (https://search.seznam.cz/indexnow) HTTP 200. No further submissions from this repo.
#18's own key (ae860ea4…) and its per-deploy ping were removed from #18 and never shipped. The deployed sitemap.xml lists exactly the 8 live URLs: home and 7 okruh pages, with no question pages.
Structured data now live: FAQPage on the 7 okruh pages, WebApplication on home only. llms.txt describes only live features.
Question pages (1136) and /zkouska-nanecisto/ are not live; they wait on the decision below (PR #18, draft, merge-ready).

decisions.question: Question pages: should every official question get its own public page?
options: 1: a page per question, as Zbrojní built them (answer + quoted provision, no JS needed, linked from okruh pages)
2: okruh pages with every question inline
decisions.default_taken: None shipped. #18 is kept as a draft, merged with main and green locally (279 unit, 23 e2e). Recommendation: 1.
decisions.why: A signature move under rule 10. Option 1 answers each question's own wording with its source, which is what search and assistants cite, and it is proven on Zbrojní. Option 2 gives a 600 KB page per okruh.

decisions.question: Mock-exam guide page /zkouska-nanecisto/: ship it?
decisions.default_taken: Held on #18 with the question pages. Recommendation: ship with Option 1.
decisions.why: It is a new kind of page, so Pavol picks.

decisions.question: Ze zákona (live since #17): keep, change or revert?
decisions.why: Correctness is guarded by a test that quotes must be verbatim in the cited paragraph. It is the main difference from paid competitors, and nothing points to harm.

decisions.question: Obraz a jméno (live since #17): keep, change or revert?
decisions.why: 144 plates were each checked against their picture, and the 27 ambiguous pictures show none. It adds one line under the picture.

decisions.question: Kontrola chyby (live since #17): keep, change or revert?
decisions.why: The conversion fires when the first round ends, so a learner who leaves the correction round still counts. Retries don't change mastery.

decisions.question: Activation: an okruh practice set is the whole okruh (35–444 questions), and no one has finished one. Change what a set is?
options: A: okruh practice in sets of 20 with a results screen after each
B: keep whole-okruh practice and point newcomers to the 10-question daily set first
decisions.why: It changes how the product teaches (a signature move), so it waits for Pavol. Recommendation: A, so a set can be finished in one sitting and question-page visitors don't land in '01 / 444'.

decisions.question: Contract test lets pending names (start_topic …) pass although the live policy still rejects them. Tighten it?
decisions.why: This follows the orchestrator's instruction that the contract test accepts start_topic. Here the typed ACCEPTED_EVENTS in src/analytics.ts still blocks pending names at typecheck, and the app sends none today.

decisions.question: IndexNow: keep #18's own key and per-deploy ping alongside the flywheel key from #19?
decisions.why: Two keys and two submitters for one host is duplication. The daily run covers new pages within a day.

next: Pavol: pick an option for the question pages (and the guide page) and for activation set size; review the three live moves.

If Option 1: undraft #18, run code-review at high on it, merge, read back /otazka/13-chodec-smi-vstoupit-na-prechod-pro-chodce/ and /sitemap.xml (1145 URLs), and let the daily IndexNow run pick them up.
flywheel: fix the analytics guard in the kit to match https://<ref>.supabase.co, because supabase-js carries '*.supabase.co' and the bare string passes config-less builds.
flywheel: the BOT_UA regex matches real phones of the Cubot brand ('CUBOT' hits bot\b), and the bare 'preview' is broad. Anchor the bot match and drop 'preview' (bingpreview covers the crawler).
flywheel: the contract test treats pending names as accepted; consider checking events minus pending once the start_topic migration is applied.
Log the one manual IndexNow submission (2026-10-28T03:50Z, 8 URLs, Bing 202, Seznam 200) in flywheel data/launch-log/autoskola-kviz.jsonl.
